name: Steel-frame barn (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Steel portal-frame farm barn and machine shed, 20 x 14 m, 5 m to the eaves: green-painted I-section frames, precast concrete panels to 1.5 m with green profiled steel sheeting above, a grey sheeted duo-pitch roof with clear roof lights, gutters and downpipes. A 6 x 4.6 m opening in the front with its two sliding leaves parked open on an outside track, steel bump posts at the jambs, and a personnel door in the west gable. Inside: a concrete floor, big square hay bales stacked three high in the west bay, black-wrapped round bales in the east bay and an empty, line-marked tractor bay behind the doors. Enterable: one room (barn).
